v5::en::NousResearch发布了Token Superpositi: NousResearch has released Token Superposition Training (TST), a method to improve the standard large language model pre-training process. Its core is to have the model read and predict consecutive token packets during the first third of training, average the input embeddings, and predict the next token packet using an improved cross-entropy loss; the remaining training time reverts to standard next token prediction. The method has been validated at 270M, 600M, 3B dense models, and 10B to 1B mixed expert model scales.

By writing natural language subtasks, assigning them to different large models for execution, and accurately specifying context information, the model's performance comprehensively surpasses that of a single cutting-edge model in hard-core benchmarks such as GPQA Diamond, LiveCodeBench, and AIME25. v5::en::吸引子模型解决了循环Transformer训练不稳定、成本高和深: The attractor model solves the problems of unstable, high cost and fixed depth of cyclic Transformer training. It generates the initial output embedding through the backbone module, the attractor module iteratively optimizes the fixed point, and uses implicit differentiation to calculate the gradient, making the training memory independent of the effective depth and adaptive convergence of the iteration number. In language modeling, compared with the standard Transformer, the perplexity is reduced by up to 46.6%, the accuracy of downstream tasks is increased by up to 19.7%, and the training cost is lower; the performance of a 770M parameter model is better than that of the 1.3B parameter Transformer. In the inference task, with only about 1,000 examples, the 27 million parameter model achieved an accuracy of 91.4% and 93.1% on Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Hard, respectively, which is better than leading models such as Claude and GPT o3. The model also exhibits the phenomenon of equilibrium internalization. After training, the initial output embedding is close to the equilibrium state. The solver can be removed during inference with almost no loss in performance, achieving the scalability of iterative optimization.

The study analyzed 2,614 trajectories and found that of the 1,815 evaluable pass trajectories, 10.7% were "lucky passes", manifested by problems such as regression loops and blind retries. Based on the quality score, passing trajectories are divided into three levels: lucky, solid and ideal, with the lucky passing rate of different models ranging from 0.5% to 23.2%. v5::en::研究团队与百余名专业创作者历时一年，构建了一个视频描述生成流程，: The research team worked with more than a hundred professional creators for a year to build a video description generation process. The core of it is to expand refined human-AI collaborative supervision rather than simply expanding the model size. This study (selected as a CVPR 2026 highlight paper) points out that current mainstream video generation models have obvious deficiencies in understanding and generating professional cinematic camera movements (such as Hitchcockian sliding zooms, precise focus shifts, or Dutch angle shots), often producing generic or incorrectly focused images. v5::en::研究团队发布IndustryBench，这是一个基于中国国家标准: The research team released IndustryBench, a 2049-item Chinese industrial procurement Q&A benchmark based on Chinese national standards (GB/T) and industrial product records, and provides a multi-language aligned version. During construction, the verification process based on external search rejected 70.3% of large language model generation problems, highlighting the unreliability of model filtering alone. The evaluation of multi-language models found that: the best system score (0-3 point scale) is only 2.083 points, with huge room for improvement; "standards and terminology" are common capability shortcomings; extended reasoning will reduce the security adjustment scores of most models due to the introduction of unfounded security-critical details; security violation inspections will significantly change model rankings. Research shows that large language model evaluation in the industrial field needs to be based on source text and be security-conscious, rather than relying on simple aggregate accuracy.
v5::en::研究团队推出MEMLENS基准，系统评估大型视觉语言模型在多模态: The research team launched the MEMLENS benchmark to systematically evaluate the long-term memory capabilities of large-scale visual language models in multi-modal multi-turn conversations. The benchmark contains 789 questions covering the five major memory abilities and tested at four standard context lengths. After evaluating 27 long context models and 7 memory enhancement agents, it was found that: the long context model performed well in short conversations but performance declined as the conversation lengthened; the memory agent length stability was good but visual fidelity was lost. Multi-round inference tasks limit the performance of most systems to less than 30%, indicating the need for hybrid architectures that combine long-context attention with structured multi-modal retrieval.
v5::en::研究提出了一种探索感知的强化学习框架，使LLM智能体能够在不确定: The research proposes an exploration-aware reinforcement learning framework that enables LLM agents to conduct adaptive exploration only when uncertainty is high. This method designs a fine-grained reward function through variational reasoning, evaluates the potential of exploratory actions to improve future decisions, and introduces an exploration-aware grouping mechanism to separate exploratory actions from task completion actions during the optimization process. Experiments show that the method achieves sustained performance improvements in a series of text- and GUI-based agent benchmarks. The relevant code and models have been open sourced on GitHub and HuggingFace platforms.

v5::en::针对传统检索无法理解复杂意图、而前沿大语言模型成本高且存在幻觉的: In order to solve the problem that traditional retrieval cannot understand complex intentions, and cutting-edge large language models are costly and have hallucinations, the research team proposed a self-evolving intelligent document retrieval system PaSaMaster. The system transforms document retrieval into a dynamic evolution process through iterative intent analysis, retrieval and sorting, and adopts three key designs: it uses sorting evidence to reveal information gaps to optimize search; it defines retrieval as an intent-paper relevance ranking task, fundamentally eliminating false documents; it improves efficiency by separating planning and retrieval, using only large models to understand intent, and leaving large-scale retrieval and scoring to lightweight models. In a benchmark test covering 38 subjects, the system increased the F1 score of traditional keyword retrieval by 15.6 times, completely eliminating the document illusion, and its performance exceeded GPT-5.2 by 30%, with a computational cost of only 1% of the latter.
v5::en::针对多跳检索增强生成（RAG）中推理过程隐式、检索漂移及错误难以: In order to solve the problems of implicit inference process, retrieval drift and difficult self-checking of errors in multi-hop retrieval enhanced generation (RAG), the research team proposed the PyRAG framework to reconstruct the multi-hop inference task into a program synthesis and execution process. This framework writes inference steps as executable Python programs, and implements multi-step calculations by explicitly calling retrieval and question-and-answer tools, making intermediate states variable, feedback deterministic, and generating a complete and checkable reasoning trajectory. This method supports compiler-based self-healing and execution-driven adaptive retrieval without additional training. In five question and answer benchmarks including PopQA and HotpotQA, PyRAG significantly outperformed the baseline model in both no-training and reinforcement learning training settings, especially on the combined multi-hop data set. Related resources have been open source.

v5::zh::Next, Local Qwen 3.6 vs frontier: 接下来，本地 Qwen 3.6 与编码原语上的前沿模型：单文件 HTML 画布驱动动画 - 结果和 GIF。作者在 Perplexity 上的前沿模型和 8 GB RX 5700 XT 上的本地量化上运行了相同的提示——带有视差风景的汽车的单文件 HTML 画布。 Kimi k2.6 Thinking 产生了最干净的视觉效果，但第四季度的本地 Qwen3.6-27B 在自然视差和底盘运动方面令人惊讶地超过了一些前沿输出。最快的本地量化是 4B 和 9B 变体。作者询问前沿模型是否应该做得更好。
v5::zh::Next, Strix Halo llama.cpp multi: 接下来，Strix Halo llama.cpp 多令牌预测基准：Qwen3.6 27B 变得更快，而 35B-A3B 是混合的。在配备 Radeon 8060S 的 AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 Strix Halo 上，对 Qwen3.6 27B 和 35B-A3B 上 llama.cpp 的多令牌预测草稿模式进行基准测试显示出清晰的模式：生成吞吐量全面上升，而即时处理速度减慢。 27B 在五回合的长聊天中可以节省高达 26% 的通话时间，而 35B-A3B 的结局大致平局或稍慢。工作负载形状决定了胜利者——解码重负载有利于多令牌预测，预填充重负载则不然。
v5::zh::Next, Could an RTX 5090 push Qwe: 接下来，RTX 5090 能否使用 Open-dLLM 扩散将 Qwen 3.6 推至每秒超过 3000 个令牌。发布者分叉了 Open-dLLM 扩散语言模型代码库，并使用免费编码代理将其升级为 Qwen3.6，融合了最近潜在扩散语言模型论文中的技术。单个 RTX 5090 上未经训练的吞吐量估计在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上以 10 个扩散步骤达到每秒 3238 个令牌，以 4 个步骤达到约 6500 个令牌，而密集的 27B 则慢得多。作者强调这些数字来自随机权重，并正在寻求计算学分来实际训练。
v5::zh::Next, Why is no one discussing t: 接下来，为什么没有人讨论 Luce megakernel 来实现更快、更节能的本地推理。作者询问为什么 Luce 团队的巨型内核版本（与他们更知名的 DFlash 和 PFlash 作品一起发布）几乎没有被讨论。据报道，megakernel 通过消除层边界之间的 CPU 调度，在 Nvidia GPU 上实现了 1.8 倍的加速和更高的能效，取代了 llama.cpp 目前执行的每个令牌大约 100 次 CUDA 内核启动。发帖者想知道这与 llama.cpp 现有的 fused-delta 内核相比如何，并向社区询问上下文。
v5::zh::Next, Reduce your GPU power limi: 接下来，降低 GPU 功率限制。一位自称外行的人在游戏卡上运行 Qwen3.5 9B 时使用 MSI Afterburner 来扫描 GPU 功率限制，测量令牌处理和生成。结论是：降低功率限制几乎不会损害推理性能，并且核心或内存时钟调整也几乎没有影响。将内存时钟提高 700 至 1000 兆赫可实现适度的生成加速。作者承认自己不是专家，并分享这些数字作为其他人的随意起点。
v5::zh::Next, macOS support in Lemonade: 接下来，Lemonade 中的 macOS 支持已经结束测试版！。 Lemonade 是一个类似于 LM Studio 和 Ollama 的本地 AI 运行时，已将其 macOS 支持移出测试版。所有主要功能现在都可以在 Mac 上运行，包括 OmniRouter、编码、图像生成、语音生成和转录。该团队强调其开源、零遥测立场、一个 3 MB 的便携式二进制文件，通过单一代码库针对 Linux、Windows 和 macOS，以及图像和语音的全模式输入和输出。 iPhone 配套应用程序即将推出。
v5::zh::Next, How I started programming: 接下来，我如何在去年以不同的方式开始编程。你呢？。一位资深程序员描述了他们的工作流程如何发生变化：他们不再使用 in-IDE LLM 自动完成功能，并且他们一年前编写的文件上下文馈送脚本也消失了。今天，他们打开一个编码代理 CLI，而不启动 IDE，使用 at-mentions 指向文件，并依靠代理来读取日志、编写测试，并遵循分解为小任务的 plan.md。 IDE 主要用于 Git diff 可视化、逐步调试和代码导航。
v5::zh::Next, OpenReader 3.0 ships open-: 接下来，OpenReader 3.0 提供开源阅读文档服务器，具有高质量的文本转语音和有声读物导出功能。 OpenReader 3.0 是一款开源 Next.js Web 应用程序，用于阅读和收听 EPUB、PDF、TXT、Markdown 和 DOCX 文件。它支持 OpenAI、Replicate、Deepinfra 和自托管文本转语音后端（如 Kokoro-FastAPI 和 KittenTTS-FastAPI），将文档和音频存储在您自己的服务器上，并通过 ffmpeg 导出带有章节元数据的 m4b 或 mp3 有声读物。新版本添加了多页音频预加载、持久服务器端缓存、多提供商密钥的管理面板以及运行时功能标志。
